title: Decomposition
group: BIO-EVOL / BIO-ECOL / BIO-PLANT — Evolution, Ecology & Plants
examples: What are the main things that break down dead plants?
How does composting help the soil?

explain.say: Decomposition is the process where dead organic matter breaks down.
Temperature is a key factor affecting how fast decomposition happens.
Moisture level is another important factor for decomposers to work well.
Compost is a useful product made by controlled decomposition of waste.
Biogas is gas produced when organic matter decomposes without oxygen.
In everyday life, kitchen scraps are often used to create compost for gardens.

draw.text: Real life: Kitchen scraps to soil

faq.q: What are the main decomposers in nature?
faq.a: Fungi and bacteria are the main decomposers in nature. They break down complex organic materials into simpler substances.

faq.q: Is oxygen needed for decomposition to happen?
faq.a: Oxygen is needed for aerobic decomposition, which is fast. Without it, anaerobic decomposition occurs.
asks: What happens when there is no oxygen?

faq.q: How is biogas useful for humans?
faq.a: Biogas is primarily methane, which can be burned to produce heat or electricity. It is a renewable energy source.
asks: Can we get energy from waste?

faq.q: What is the difference between compost and biogas?
faq.a: Compost is a solid, nutrient-rich material used for soil. Biogas is a gaseous fuel produced during decomposition.
asks: Are compost and biogas the same?

faq.q: Why is decomposition important for the ecosystem?
faq.a: It is vital because it recycles essential nutrients back into the soil for new plants to use. Without it, nutrients would become locked up.
asks: What happens to nutrients without decay?

facts: Decomposers include bacteria, fungi, and some invertebrates.
Aerobic decomposition requires oxygen and is generally faster.
Biogas is mainly composed of methane gas.

quiz.say: If a pile of leaves decomposes in a sealed, underground space, what type of decomposition is most likely occurring?
quiz.why: This process occurs in the absence of oxygen, which is typical in sealed underground spaces.

wrong.1: This process requires oxygen, which is not available underground.
wrong.2: Composting is a controlled method, not necessarily what happens naturally underground.
wrong.3: This is a different process related to nitrogen, not the breakdown of matter.

quiz.say: What is the primary usable gas found in biogas?
quiz.why: Methane is the main component of biogas and can be burned for energy.

wrong.0: While CO2 is released, methane is the primary fuel gas.
wrong.1: Oxygen is needed for aerobic decay, not the production of biogas.
wrong.2: Nitrogen gas is usually present but is not the main energy source in biogas.

quiz.say: Which factor would most significantly slow down the rate of decomposition in a compost heap?
quiz.why: Decomposers are living organisms, and low temperatures slow down their metabolic rates.

wrong.0: Bacteria are decomposers and speed up the process, they do not slow it.
wrong.1: Nitrogen sources help speed up the process by providing food for decomposers.
wrong.3: High moisture is generally good, up to a point, for decomposition.
